description: This file declares the exported API functions for the Slap Bmc2 Server Object, used in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) implementation. It includes function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the server object, as well as functions related to the SLAP object call map and descriptor.

methods.name: SlapCreateBmc2Server
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Bmc2 Server object with provided container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapBmc2SrvoGetSlapObjCallMap
methods.description: Retrieves the call map object associated with the SLAP Bmc2 Server object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2SrvoGetSlapObjDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptor object for the SLAP Bmc2 Server.

methods.name: SlapBmc2SrvoCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new instance of the SLAP Bmc2 Server object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2SrvoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the SLAP Bmc2 Server instance.

methods.name: SlapBmc2SrvoEnrolObjects
methods.description: Enrols necessary sub-objects for the SLAP Bmc2 Server instance.

methods.name: SlapBmc2SrvoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the SLAP Bmc2 Server object, setting up its internal state.
